question: Should Twilio RCS remain a separately installed channel plugin, or should OpenClaw sponsor it as a bundled core-distributed channel despite the current SMS and VISION.md precedent?
rationale: The implementation is feasible through plugin seams, repository direction defaults optional channels to external distribution, and the paired issue exists specifically to record an exception if bundling is desired. citeturn2view3turn9search3

options.title: Keep RCS external
options.body: Publish the channel through ClawHub/npm and split out only any proven generic SDK seam needed by both SMS and RCS.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept the larger bundled configuration, dependency, webhook, and support surface after live proof, dependency authorization, and compatibility review.

recommendation.title: Keep RCS external
recommendation.body: Publish the channel through ClawHub/npm and split out only any proven generic SDK seam needed by both SMS and RCS.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the closest Twilio SMS channel precedent and are the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether RCS receives different distribution treatment.
